verdict.rationale: Puzzle markets an 'Embedded Accounting' API and an MCP integration that lets Claude read financial data conversationally, showing some API-driven access exists, but there is no documentation of a full API reference or evidence that write-heavy UI workflows (invoicing, reconciliation, AI Close, journal entries) are exposed via API — probes for OpenAPI/swagger specs all returned 404. Missing for 10: published API reference covering all UI actions, evidence of write/create operations via API, and independent confirmation of feature parity.
